channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike Conley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike Conley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley:

“Mike Conley was an All-Star in the NBA. I think people forget about that. Once upon a time, he was one of the best point guards in the league. I always tell him that you used to be one of my favorite players. When I played 2K, I played with you.”

Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley, May 5, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Kyle Korver, Mike Conley, Cristiano Ronaldo, Tom Brady
item.description:
Rudy Gobert:

“Yeah. Yeah. The first time I heard about a hyperbaric chamber, I was in Utah, and it was Kyle Korver. I know Tom Brady had one, Cristiano Ronaldo had one. Since I’m someone who wants to optimize my potential, I ordered one right away. I even gave one to Mike Conley. You always have to take care of your point guards.”

Rudy Gobert on Kyle Korver, Mike Conley, Cristiano Ronaldo, Tom Brady, Mar 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Mike Conley
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on Mike Conley:

“For me, Mike has been a guy that I have a tremendous amount of respect for and love and friendship. So obviously, this morning on the bus, looking next to me on the bus and seeing an empty seat, it hit me a little bit.”

Rudy Gobert on Mike Conley, Feb 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Zach Randolph, Mike Conley
item.description:
[Highlight] Klay Thompson:

“I actually do have a lot of respect for the grind house, Mike Conley, Zach Randolph, and MarcGasol…This new team though, I don’t know man. They just talk a lot. They’ve always talked a lot, and never really backed it up either. So, I don’t really respect that...”

Klay Thompson on Zach Randolph, Mike Conley, Nov 24, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley
item.description:
“I’m 23. I get to do it a whole bunch of times. I’m hurt more so for Mike (Conley). I came up short for Mike. We tried last year, we couldn’t get it. We tried again this year. We’ll try again next year. But hurt is a terrible word to use. I’m good.”

Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley, May 29, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Julius Randle on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles
item.description:
Jonah: Julius Randle on Mike Conley and Joe Ingles' veteran leadership:

“I’ve talked all year about the leader that he is (Conley) for our team, and how he kinda keeps us balanced. -- How he or Joe is able to pull me to the side. Keep me level-headed. -- Those guys are huge.”

Julius Randle on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, May 9, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Julius Randle on Mike Conley
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Julius Randle on Mike Conley:

“Every single one of us in this locker room has been extremely frustrated at one point but Mike. That just shows you who he is as a person and a player in this locker room, what he means to this team. He keeps everyone level-headed. Mike’s amazing.”

Julius Randle on Mike Conley, Jan 23, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tony Allen on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol
item.description:
Tony Allen:

“Then he looks dead at Z-Bo. He’s like, 'Z-Bo, get a [explicit] rebound that matters! Quit telling Mike to move out to get rebounds!' I’m like, 'Damn!' Then he looks dead at Marc (Gasol). He’s like, 'Marc, who the [explicit] told you you were our Sabonis? Get your ass in the paint and make some points!' I’m sitting there like, 'Damn, coach is on one.'Then he looks at Mike Conley and says, 'Mike Conley, you know what happened?' Man, I swear, coach was just on everybody that day, but I respected it because it was tough love. That’s the type of energy I’ve been looking for, and it made me want to run through a wall for him.”

Tony Allen on Mike Conley, Marc Gasol, Nov 24, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Mike Conley
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Nikola Jokic on whether the Timberwolves and Nuggets are rivals:

“Yes. I think they’re built to beat us. They have basically two All-Stars, two All-Defensive First Team players, and Mike Conley, who’s the most underrated player in the NBA probably. I love the guy. He’s so good.”

Nikola Jokic on Mike Conley, May 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mike Conley
item.description:
Michael Malone on Game 1:

“Too many discipline breakdowns. You can't go under Mike Conley (on screens). There's a reason Mike Conley kicks our ass every time we play him.”

Michael Malone on Mike Conley, May 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Porter on Mike Conley, Jaden McDaniels, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Michael Porter on the balance between single covering and doubling Anthony Edwards, who took 29 shots tonight:

“Any good team has multiple weapons. one thing that makes us successful is that when teams double Joker, we’ve got capable guys that can make shots. Similar with them, if you double Ant, you may be swinging the ball to KAT or Mike Conley or Jaden McDaniels. All capable guys. It’s definitely a balance, and it’s something we’ve gotta look at on film.”

Michael Porter on Mike Conley, Jaden McDaniels, Anthony Edwards, May 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Mike Conley
item.description:
“I missed my first 17 shots. Which is almost a record coming into the league… Another time was when Mike Conley whooped me… I was like, Yo, I can’t hang with this guy.”

Jamal Murray on Mike Conley, May 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Naz Reid on Mike Conley
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Naz Reid on Mike Conley:

“He’s like young Mike again. You can tell he’s having fun. ... He’s dancing with us. He’s excited. He’s happy and it turns over to his play. He’s getting a lot of good looks, making a lot of shots, being aggressive. That’s what we need when KAT’s out.”

Naz Reid on Mike Conley, Mar 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on the late bank shot:

“I told Mike [Conley] when they made the [previous] shot to just give me the ball and move out of the way, because I work on it every day. I knew once I got to that spot, I was going glass.”

Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley, Dec 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Chris Finch on Mike Conley
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Chris Finch on Mike Conley:

“He’s everybody’s big brother. Calm, steady. Not super vocal in any rah-rah way but when he talks, everyone is listening. ... Whether he wanted to be the leader of this team or not, our guys look to him, and he’s taken it and run with it.”

Chris Finch on Mike Conley, Dec 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on what Mike Conley said to him late in the game:

“Mike just tells me, ‘No more 3s, man. Get inside the three-point line. It ain’t falling.’ He pretty much just told me to get to the line. ... My middy started to fall late. That helped me a lot.”

Anthony Edwards on Mike Conley, Nov 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: LeBron James on Mike Conley, Karl-Anthony Towns, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“When you got guys like KAT [Karl-Anthony Towns] and Anthony Edwards, those guys can both go for 40 against you. ... You have a very cerebral, solid point guard in Mike Conley who's been in multiple playoff games. So, listen, we know what we're getting ourselves into.”

LeBron James on Mike Conley, Karl-Anthony Towns, Anthony Edwards, Apr 9, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Finch on Mike Conley, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Chris Finch on Mike Conley helping Rudy Gobert:

“I think you see it. The chemistry is obvious. We could’ve played another 40 games and just begin to develop that. ... He wants it to work. Understands how to make it work & can play well off each other. I think Rudy has got a pep in his step.”

Chris Finch on Mike Conley, Rudy Gobert, Mar 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Kyle Anderson on Mike Conley
item.description:
Kyle Anderson on late-game offense:

“It’s tough. We’re still figuring it out. We were still trying to figure it out w/ D-Lo. Then we got Mike Conley coming in. It’s something else we got to figure out & whoever the 5 is ... we have to figure out a way to make it happen.”

Kyle Anderson on Mike Conley, Feb 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Dennis Lindsey, on re-signing Mike Conley, and the associated cost:

“I'm limited in what I can say … but who he is, what he stands for, the speed, skill, intelligence … it's an honor to have him as part of the program.… [But] he's got to go vet his market.”

Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Jun 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Dennis Lindsey:

“We really appreciate Mike Conley attempting to play last night. There were some struggles. We never put any pressure on a guy to play.”

Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Jun 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Joe Ingles on Mike Conley
item.description:
Joe Ingles on Mike Conley's free agency:

“My daughter will be upset if Myles (Conley's son) isn't in her class”

Joe Ingles on Mike Conley, Jun 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Mike Conley
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on Mike Conley:

“Not only is he a great player, but he's one of the best human beings that I've ever had an opportunity to be with on a daily basis.”

Quin Snyder on Mike Conley, Jun 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Mike Conley, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Donovan Mitchell and Mike Conley injury situations:

“They won't be put there if there's a chance they could further hurt themselves.… The impact that they have, even if they're not at their best, is substantial.”

Quin Snyder on Mike Conley, Donovan Mitchell, Jun 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Mike Conley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Ty Lue, on the potential return of Mike Conley to the Jazz for Game 6:

“Our game plan stays the same. If we have to adjust, we will.… We'll see how he plays.”

Tyronn Lue on Mike Conley, Jun 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Mike Conley
item.description:
Quin Snyder, on Mike Conley's status:

“He's making progress. As far as the exact position he's in in terms of that progress, that's a day-to-day thing. I don't comment on individual injuries. …We all know he wants to be back and that's what he's working towards.”

Quin Snyder on Mike Conley, Jun 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Mike Conley
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Quin Snyder on Conley missing Game 3 with the hammy:

“It has nothing to do with us feeling any form of accomplishment having won a couple games -- Mike's not ready to go yet.”

Quin Snyder on Mike Conley, Jun 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Jordan Clarkson on Mike Conley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Jordan Clarkson, on Mike Conley's absence:

“It's just gonna push other guys to step up tonight. … We still gotta stay aggressive, take our shots, stick to the system. It's a huge void to fill.”

Jordan Clarkson on Mike Conley, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Mike Conley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Donovan Mitchell, on the importance of Mike Conley:

“He’s seen a lot, he was part of an 8 seed that beat a 1 seed. … He’s a calm and cooling presence. Never seen Mike have a bad day, which helps keep the mood light.”

Donovan Mitchell on Mike Conley, Jun 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Mike Conley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on what determines if Mike Conley plays both halves of a B2B:

“Rudy's got a crystal that we consult, and we rub it for awhile and try to come up with a result that Mike likes.”

Quin Snyder on Mike Conley, Apr 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.
